definition.splitting: C_t has a QQ-rational branch point; for a degree-two cover this is equivalent to the specialized cover value being a square.
definition.translation_invariance: Translating C by a generic section changes P by an element of M_t, so the visible quotient class is unchanged.
definition.visible_space: The QQ-span of classes of rational points P on the fibre E_t that occur on a geometrically integral multisection C in the declared atlas.
